scenes.say: Just finished dinner? Don't sit down yet. Take a ten minute walk instead.
scenes.headline: DON'T SIT DOWN YET

scenes.say: Head out soon after eating, keep an easy pace, and go for about ten minutes.
scenes.headline: THE 10-MINUTE HABIT

scenes.say: So swap the couch for a quick stroll around the block.
scenes.headline: COUCH TO STROLL

scenes.say: In a study of forty one adults with type two diabetes, walks after meals cut post meal blood sugar twelve percent.
scenes.headline: SHORT WALKS WORK
scenes.sub: Lower vs one 30-min walk a day

scenes.say: But here's the surprise. Dinner was where the walk helped the most.
scenes.headline: DINNER IS THE BIG ONE

scenes.say: After dinner, blood sugar was twenty two percent lower. It's often our biggest carb meal.
scenes.headline: 22% LOWER AFTER DINNER

scenes.say: No time for ten? Even two to five minutes of light walking helps, and standing beats sitting.
scenes.headline: NO TIME? GO SHORT

scenes.say: So tonight, after dinner, put on your shoes and walk ten minutes. It's an easy win for blood sugar.
scenes.headline: TONIGHT: WALK 10
